notes: Re-reviewed on options_thesis_refresh_due (structure_now_passes) after Q1 FY27 print. Thesis intact. Catalyst hit: revenue $81.6B beat, Q2 guide $91B excluding China, GM stable at 75%, $80B incremental buyback, dividend 25x, DC networking +199% Y/Y. Spot dipped ~1% to $221.56 but IV crushed on the back month (~45%) which allowed Jun18 240/250 call debit vertical to clear gates as a shadow paper position. Keep gates and target intact; do not chase tighter strikes from the same poll.

theses.thesis: NVIDIA remains the liquid public proxy for frontier-compute scaling. Upside target is 250.22 by the 2026-06-18 option expiry if accelerator supply, hyperscaler AI capex, or frontier-compute scarcity reprices faster than the current option structure implies.
theses.catalyst: earnings, accelerator supply/capex guide, export-control update, or hyperscaler AI capex revision inside the June 18 options window
theses.plannedExit: first liquid mark after catalyst or thesis invalidation; otherwise close before expiry week
theses.falsifier: datacenter accelerator demand or margins decelerate, export controls bind harder than modeled, hyperscaler capex revisions weaken, or option IV/spreads absorb the edge
